title: Verify Playwright Insights View Integration for Functional Tests
description: Ensure that the Playwright insights view is correctly integrated and displays accurate data for functional tests.
testDescription: Test the integration of Playwright insights view with existing insights for functional tests, ensuring data accuracy and seamless integration.
prerequisites: Functional tests must be configured and executed in the system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Execute a set of functional tests using Playwright.
2. Navigate to the insights view section.
3. Verify that the insights for the executed functional tests are displayed.
4. Check for data accuracy and completeness in the insights view.
expectedResult: The insights view should display accurate and complete data for the executed functional tests, integrated seamlessly with existing insights.

title: Boundary Value Analysis for Numeric Fields in Insights
description: Validate the handling of boundary values for numeric fields within the Playwright insights view.
testDescription: Perform boundary value analysis on numeric fields to ensure they handle edge cases correctly.
prerequisites: Functional tests with numeric data fields must be available.
stepsToPerform:
1. Identify numeric fields in the insights view.
2. Input boundary values (e.g., minimum, maximum, just above minimum, just below maximum).
3. Verify the insights view handles these values correctly without errors.
expectedResult: Numeric fields should handle boundary values correctly, displaying accurate insights without errors.

title: State Transition Testing for Workflow Changes
description: Ensure accurate state transitions in workflows when integrating Playwright insights.
testDescription: Test state transitions in workflows to ensure they reflect accurately in the Playwright insights view.
prerequisites: Workflows with defined state transitions must be set up.
stepsToPerform:
1. Execute a workflow with multiple state transitions.
2. Navigate to the Playwright insights view.
3. Verify that each state transition is accurately reflected in the insights.
expectedResult: All state transitions should be accurately captured and displayed in the Playwright insights view.

title: Decision Table Testing for Role-Based Access
description: Validate role-based access and permissions within the Playwright insights view.
testDescription: Use decision table testing to ensure different user roles have appropriate access to the insights view.
prerequisites: User roles and permissions must be configured in the system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Identify different user roles and their permissions.
2. Attempt to access the insights view with each role.
3. Verify that access is granted or denied based on role permissions.
expectedResult: Users should have access to the insights view according to their role-based permissions.

title: Data Integrity and Consistency Checks
description: Ensure data integrity and consistency in the Playwright insights view.
testDescription: Validate that the data displayed in the insights view is consistent and accurately reflects the results of functional tests.
prerequisites: Functional tests must be executed and results available.
stepsToPerform:
1. Execute functional tests and generate results.
2. Navigate to the Playwright insights view.
3. Compare the insights data with the actual test results for consistency.
expectedResult: The insights view should consistently reflect the actual results of the functional tests.

title: Alert Classification and Override Validation
description: Manage alerts generated by the Playwright insights view and validate override functionality.
testDescription: Test the classification of alerts and the ability to override them in the insights view.
prerequisites: Alerts must be configured to trigger based on specific conditions in functional tests.
stepsToPerform:
1. Execute functional tests that trigger alerts.
2. Navigate to the Playwright insights view.
3. Verify the classification of alerts.
4. Attempt to override alerts and confirm the changes are reflected.
expectedResult: Alerts should be correctly classified, and overrides should be accurately reflected in the insights view.

title: End-to-End Workflow Test for Insights Generation
description: Conduct a comprehensive end-to-end test from functional test initiation to insights validation.
testDescription: Test the entire workflow from starting a functional test, generating insights, and validating the accuracy and completeness of the insights.
prerequisites: Functional tests must be set up and ready for execution.
stepsToPerform:
1. Initiate a functional test.
2. Allow the test to complete and generate insights.
3. Navigate to the insights view.
4. Validate the accuracy and completeness of the insights data.
5. Check for any intermediate saves, validations, recalculations, and alerts.
expectedResult: The insights view should accurately and completely reflect the results of the functional test, with all intermediate actions correctly processed.
